{{Quote|Help me, help me, help me!|San Maxus|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Crash Course">''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]''</ref>}}
'''San Maxus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] that competed in the race in the [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]] against [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was also a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] that was called '''Agent Sixteen''' by [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] himself.

==Biography==
San Maxus received a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned [[Messo]] and attempted to hand it off to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] hand [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in return for his payoff. Upon reaching the [[Skeleton Straits]] of the course, San became engaged in a three-way [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] battle between him, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Kidd Kareen]]. Ventress appeared on the hull of San's podracer to receive the data file, but was foiled by Ahsoka who began to fight her with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] who [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Crush|Force crushed]] the datafile. San was left in peril when Ahsoka sliced his podracer in half in mid-flight. However he did not die when his remaining section crashed, as Kidd Kareen later said that he "retired", telling in fact he wasn't dead.
